Horrible Experience. We have other great guys that charge a flat fee of 80 per car/truck/suv. Johnny came by to advertise G&G on Wednesday, letting us know it was $65. We thought what the heck, let's try them and see. We called them last Thursday and now they said it was $80, that the sixty five was only for 15 cars and up, that we needed to give em more volume?! We figured no problem since that's what we pay anyway. On Friday morning,  February 3, 2017 they got 2 SUV's from us. They said they will drop em off on Saturday morning. Saturday went by and no drop off, we call and he said it was to dirty will probably be done by Monday now. On monday, one of the units was delivered the other was delivered barely today!! and on top of it, we were charged $108.00 per unit. Not satisfied with overall customer service nor the deceitfulness of prices. Be aware of this establishment.
